$comment: 絵の台帳（docs/rendering-requirements.md §4.1 の2）。heightTiles は基準タイルの幅を1とした絵の高さ。body はそのまま API に送り、refs は art/sprites/<tw>/<キー>.png を参照画像として差し込む。
style: isometric pixel art in the style of a cozy city-building game, 2:1 dimetric projection, crisp single-pixel lines, light from the top-left so the right-facing wall is darker, selective outline (outline colors follow the face colors, no black outline), limited palette, no text, no letters, transparent background

sprites.description: flat isometric grass ground tile, short bright green grass with a few lighter blades, seamless edges
flat isometric paved asphalt road tile running from the upper-left edge to the lower-right edge, grey asphalt with a dashed white center line, curbs on both sides, the diamond fills the whole canvas
small two-storey wooden house standing on one isometric ground tile, red pitched roof, cream wooden walls, small windows and a door on the left face, building footprint fits inside the bottom diamond
small covered market hall standing on one isometric ground tile, blue striped awnings over open stalls with fruit crates, light stone walls, building footprint fits inside the bottom diamond
small brick factory standing on one isometric ground tile, grey saw-tooth roof with yellow trim, one tall chimney, loading door on the left face, building footprint fits inside the bottom diamond
